Adjusting Shim Selection Chart (Exhaust)

New shim thickness

Shim No. | Thickness mm (in.)
1 | 2.500 (0.0984)
2 | 2.550 (0.1004)
3 | 2.600 (0.1024)
4 | 2.650 (0.1043)
5 | 2.700 (0.1063)
6 | 2.750 (0.1083)
7 | 2.800 (0.1102)
8 | 2.850 (0.1122)
9 | 2.900 (0.1142)
10 | 2.950 (0.1161)
11 | 3.000 (0.1181)
12 | 3.050 (0.1201)

14 | 3.150 (0.1240)
15 | 3.200 (0.1260)
16 | 3.250 (0.1280)
17 | 3.300 (0.1299)

HINT: New shims have the thickness in millimeters imprinted on the face.

Exhaust valve clearance (Cold):
0.25 – 0.35 mm (0.010 – 0.014 in.)

EXAMPLE: The 2.800 mm (0.1102 in.) shim is installed, and the measured clearance is 0.450 mm (0.0177 in.).
Replace the 2.800 mm (0.1102 in.) shim with a new No.10 shim.
